CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE S.G.PANDIT  and  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE K. V. ARAVIND

ORAL ORDER (PER: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE S.G.PANDIT) Heard learned Senior Counsel Sri.P.S.Rajagopal for learned counsel Sri.Subrahmanya Bhat M., for the petitioners and learned Additional Advocate General Sri.Reuben Jacob, along with learned Additional Government Advocate Sri.V.Shivareddy for respondent Nos.1 to 3.
2.
The petitioners at present are working as Food Safety Officers in the Commissionerate of Food Safety at various places.
Initially, they are the employees of Health and Family Welfare Service Department.
They are working as Food Safety Officers since 2011 in pursuance to the notification dated 30.07.2011 (Annexure-A7) and notification dated 05.08.2011 (Annexure-A8).

Under Official Memorandum (OM) dated 25.07.2025 (Annexure- A33), the petitioners are relieved as Food Safety Officers and are directed to report to duty at the Office of NC: 2025:KHC:32060-DB HC-KAR Commissioner, Health and Family Welfare Services as Junior/Senior Health Inspectors and to seek further posting.
Questioning the said OM and other allied prayers, the petitioners were before the Tribunal in Application Nos.3561-3579/2025.
The petitioners had also sought for interim prayer to stay the impugned OM dated 23.07.2025 (Annexure-A32) and 25.07.2025 (Annexure-A33).
Under impugned order dated 06.08.2025, the Tribunal rejected the petitioners interim prayer to stay the OM's dated 23.07.2025 (Annexure-A32) and 25.07.2025 (Annexure- A33).
3. Challenging the said rejection of interim prayer, the petitioners are before this Court in this writ petition.
4. Learned senior counsels appearing for the parties have canvassed several contentions and they have taken us through the various orders passed on the subject matter on earlier round of litigation.

However, the fact remains that petitioners are working as Food Safety - 10 - NC: 2025:KHC:32060-DB HC-KAR Officers since 2011 in the Commissionarate of Food Safety.
5.
Learned senior counsel appearing for the parties would submit that the application in question is posted to 28.08.2025.
Further, learned Additional Advocate General Sri.Reuben Jacob would assure that by 28.08.2025, the pleadings would be completed.
6. Thereafter, on serving of the statement of objections by the State, the petitioners are given one week time to file rejoinder statement.
Thereafter, learned counsel Sri.Subramanya Bhat who appears for the petitioners before the Tribunal also assures that they would commence arguments on the main application itself.

8 7.

Taking note of the above assurances by the counsels appearing for the parties and also taking note of the fact that the petitioners are working as Food Safety Officers for the last 14 years in the Commissionerate of Food Safety, we deem it appropriate to direct the - 11 - NC: 2025:KHC:32060-DB HC-KAR respondents to continue the petitioners as Food Safety Officers in the Commissionerate of Food Safety at the places where the petitioners are working for the present till disposal of the application.
8. With the above observations, writ petition stands disposed of.
We request the Tribunal to dispose of the application as early as possible, as the learned counsels appearing for the parties have assured that they would co-operate in disposal of the application.
In view of disposal of the petition, pending interlocutory application would not survive and it stands disposed of accordingly.

In view of disposal of the petition, pending interlocutory application would not survive and it stands disposed of accordingly.
